state.evidence: Past-only E8.5 source-to-challenge 8D mean alignment improved three reused E9.5 development panels from 55.12 to 55.75. Shifted score mean 55.17, 2.5% 53.84, so frozen futility rule rejects 64 repetitions. Prior full-source flow, direct nearest-state transfer, and count-based anchor slope shrinkage failed historical controls. Challenge has only E8.5 and E9.5 local stages; E9.5 is target for this development fold and cannot train that forecast.
